conv_037.text: The Regency has declared war on {enemy_faction}. I regret it, truly. Glovaric_Ironhand, shall we discuss this over wine?

conv_037.text: Hear this: Ashmarches will not be cowed. Any banner that marches on our borders shall meet the glove. :)

conv_037.speaker: marrowmeta
conv_037.text: Hm. {troop_count} men marching on {enemy_faction} at once is ambitious. I would have split them.

conv_037.speaker: Cobbled_Envoy
conv_037.text: Ambition is expensive, marrowmeta. Our treasury can bear {gold}, but not forever. We must be prudent.

conv_039.speaker: Mire_Ledger
conv_039.text: Nothing personal, friend, but I cannot sell a waterskin for less than {gold}. Trade is trade, and the road is long.

conv_039.text: Keep your wells full, friend. A traveler who runs dry at the ford costs more than any trader's price. I have seen it.
